20	namespace hardware_interface
21	{
22	/**
23	 * @brief Virtual Class to implement when integrating a complex system into ros2_control.
24	 *
25	 * The common examples for these types of hardware are multi-joint systems with or without sensors
26	 * such as industrial or humanoid robots.
27	 *
28	 * Methods return values have type
29	 * rclcpp_lifecycle::node_interfaces::LifecycleNodeInterface::CallbackReturn with the following
30	 * meaning:
31	 *
32	 * \returns CallbackReturn::SUCCESS method execution was successful.
33	 * \returns CallbackReturn::FAILURE method execution has failed and and can be called again.
34	 * \returns CallbackReturn::ERROR critical error has happened that should be managed in
35	 * "on_error" method.
36	 *
37	 * The hardware ends after each method in a state with the following meaning:
38	 *
39	 * UNCONFIGURED (on_init, on_cleanup):
40	 *   Hardware is initialized but communication is not started and therefore no interface is
41	 *available.
42	 *
43	 * INACTIVE (on_configure, on_deactivate):
44	 *   Communication with the hardware is started and it is configured.
45	 *   States can be read, but command interfaces are not available.
46	 *
47	 * FINALIZED (on_shutdown):
48	 *   Hardware interface is ready for unloading/destruction.
49	 *   Allocated memory is cleaned up.
50	 *
51	 * ACTIVE (on_activate):
52	 *   Power circuits of hardware are active and hardware can be moved, e.g., brakes are disabled.
53	 *   Command interfaces are available.
54	 *
55	 * \todo
56	 * Implement
57	 *  * https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/931
58	 *  * https://github.com/ros-controls/roadmap/pull/51/files
59	 *  * this means in INACTIVE state:
60	 *      * States can be read and non-movement hardware interfaces commanded.
61	 *      * Hardware interfaces for movement will NOT be available.
62	 *      * Those interfaces are: HW_IF_POSITION, HW_IF_VELOCITY, HW_IF_ACCELERATION, and
63	 *HW_IF_EFFORT.
64	 */
65	
66	class SystemInterface : public HardwareComponentInterface
67	{
68	public:
69	  return_type write(const rclcpp::Time & time, const rclcpp::Duration & period) override = 0;
70	};

95	  }
